mapper.sql: r.region_id AS regionId, r.region_code AS regionCode, r.sido_name AS sidoName, r.sigungu_name AS sigunguName, r.dong_name AS dongName, r.center_lat AS centerLat, r.center_lng AS centerLng, r.public_display_name AS publicDisplayName, r.active_yn AS activeYn, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member_profile mp WHERE mp.region_id = r.region_id) AS profileCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team t WHERE t.region_id = r.region_id) AS teamCount
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN active_yn = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS activeCount, SUM(CASE WHEN active_yn = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inactiveCount, COUNT(DISTINCT sido_name) AS sidoCount, MIN(center_lat) AS minLat, MAX(center_lat) AS maxLat, MIN(center_lng) AS minLng, MAX(center_lng) AS maxLng FROM region
mapper.update: UPDATE region SET sido_name = #{sidoName}, sigungu_name = #{sigunguName}, dong_name = #{dongName}, center_lat = #{centerLat}, center_lng = #{centerLng}, public_display_name = #{publicDisplayName}, active_yn = #{activeYn} WHERE region_id = #{regionId}
